description: Access miscellaneous public data APIs: Wikipedia summaries, IP geolocation, DNS lookups, and URL expansion. Select the sub-command and provide the relevant parameters.

command.description: Sub-command to run: wikipedia (article summary), ip_geolocation (IP location), dns_lookup (DNS records), expand_url (follow redirects)

ip.description: IP address for geolocation (e.g., "8.8.8.8"). Omit to look up your own IP.

query.description: Search term for Wikipedia (e.g., "Theory of relativity")

name: query_public_data
